sections.title: Identity And Confirmation
sections.text: Invoke document clear with explicit --doc <exact-open-name>, --doc-file-id <exact-DataFile.id>, and data {fileId:<same-id>,confirm:true}. document.status discovers result.fileId; copy that exact ID, not versionId or a filename. Shared context resolves one named Design document; the handler independently requires the pin and exact actual saved DataFile ID. Saved/valid/complete/writable statuses must be affirmative; missing, null or throwing audit properties refuse. Unsaved modifications are intentionally allowed. Root invocation scope and root edit target required. Modeling batches are disallowed.

sections.title: Audit And Supported Scope
sections.text: dryRun:true runs the same content/identity preflight under transport readOnly:true without activation, marker movement or deletes; result.before contains actual Fusion counts. --preview is only outer-key validation and never certifies contents. Audits all component definitions once, including root/descendants; occurrences count separately. Unsuppressed timeline must be at end; single-level group members are audited without UI expansion. Empty/nested groups refuse. Standalone local BRep-only base features are supported; sketches, construction geometry, meshes and linked features inside them refuse. Every leaf must have a valid entity in the explicit supported type set. Parameter model owners must belong to audited history; user dependencies on model/unknown parameters, cycles or unavailable deletability refuse. Non-Design products (even an empty CAM product), document references, configurations, direct/mesh/custom/unknown history, flat patterns, decals, PMI/custom coordinate systems, named views, selection/contact sets and analyses refuse before activation or mutation. Full SDK source references and supported type set: docs/DOCUMENT_CLEAR.md.

sections.title: Deletion And Empty Contract
sections.text: After preflight, activate the scoped document and recheck identity/completeness/editability. Set timeline.markerPosition=0 and call public Timeline.deleteAllAfterMarker once. Re-enumerate surviving canvases/custom graphics, delete user parameters in dependent-first order with current isDeletable checks, then delete all findAttributes matches plus Design.attributes and Document.attributes. Includes root aliases, frame metadata and test run markers; third-party attributes also removed by explicit full-clear confirmation. Re-audit every counted collection to zero, including timeline, snapshots, descendantComponents, occurrences, bRepBodies, sketches, features, constructionPlanes/Axes/Points, joints/asBuiltJoints/jointOrigins/rigidGroups, canvases/customGraphicsGroups, user/modelParameters and attributes. Require same saved complete writable file, and modified:true if content changed. Retain root/origins, cloud identity/name/location/metadata/versions, units, materials/appearances/rules and view/render/preferences. This is not a literal new-document reset.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Normal shared envelope has success,operation,document,result,created:[]. Dry-run result: status:inspected,dryRun:true,mutation:false,before:counts,current:{fileId,saved:true,modified:boolean,isComplete:true,readOnly:false},savePerformed:false,unsavedChanges:boolean,retained:string[]. Mutating result: status:cleared,dryRun:false,mutation:boolean,before:counts,after:all-zero-counts,current:same-status-shape,savePerformed:false,unsavedChanges:boolean,retained:string[]. Already empty designs can return mutation:false and unsavedChanges:false. Unsaved changes are never uploaded here; caller saves separately. No cloud deletion, save-as, auto-save, rollback or retry. A false SDK delete or exception propagates; post-mutation identity/audit failures never return cleared. After a partial failure inspect current contents before deciding what to do. The validated progress line is not success evidence. Offline stubs certify control flow only, not live Fusion kernel behavior.

examples.label: Inspect actual contents without mutation
examples.requires: Replace placeholder with result.fileId from document.status and Model with the exact open name. Supported saved writable complete local parametric Design, root edit target.
examples.output: result.status is inspected; result.before has actual counts; result.mutation and result.savePerformed are false.

examples.label: Clear explicitly confirmed reusable test contents
examples.requires: Replace placeholder and Model with the discovered exact file ID and open name. Confirmation authorizes destroying current test contents, including unsaved modifications and all attributes. Review dry-run first.
examples.output: result.status is cleared only after all result.after counts are zero and same cloud identity verified. result.unsavedChanges reports current dirty state. Caller saves separately.

verified: mandatory exact cloud pin and strict confirmation
false/exception propagation without retry or rollback

sections.title: Inputs And Scope
sections.text: Input is {} only. Shared context requires an explicit exact open document name and a Design product; duplicate names reject unless optional project ID distinguishes saved documents. Document name/project scoping is invocation context, not fields inside this operation's data. Reads the scoped document, not necessarily active document. No save, activation, refresh, polling, event pumping, or mutation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Normal envelope is {success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:[]}. result has name:string,creationId:string,saved:boolean,modified:boolean,fileId:string|null,fileName:string|null,version:integer|null,versionId:string|null,isComplete:boolean|null,folderId:string|null,projectId:string|null. saved reads Document.isSaved, not cloud durability. fileId/fileName come from currently observed DataFile; folderId/projectId from its parents. No DataFile means all file metadata null. versionNumber/versionId/isComplete absent on installed API also produce null. API getter exceptions propagate; they are not converted into fabricated null metadata. No status/pending/accepted fields here.

sections.title: Save-As Follow-Up
sections.text: After document.save_as retain its result.original.fileId and result.target. Poll only through explicit later status calls if needed; use the current open document name, which may change to the copy name. Completion evidence requires new fileId different from original, exact fileName matching target.name, projectId/folderId matching target IDs, saved:true,modified:false,isComplete:true. An unchanged old complete DataFile is not completion of the copy. creationId may remain unchanged across copies and is not sufficient identity. This is a live asynchronous cloud snapshot; offline tests cannot prove upload durability.

examples.label: Observe scoped document identity
examples.requires: Explicit open Design document scope; use current document name after save-as, not an assumed old name. No token needed.
examples.output: result.fileId may be null or still the original file; compare it and destination metadata against retained save-as output before concluding completion.

sections.title: Exact Destination ID Pin
sections.text: Optional expectedFolderId is a nonempty exact SDK DataFolder.id. The existing project/folder logical-path lookup still runs and rejects ambiguity; a different folder ID, including a replacement folder with the same name/path, refuses before snapshot/saveAs. The pin does not create a destination, discover another folder, authorize an existing-file overwrite or grant saved-fixture access. Omission retains the existing name/path contract.

sections.title: Native Project ID Pin
sections.text: Optional expectedProjectId is the exact observed SDK DataProject.id, not an inferred Manufacturing Data workspace ID. Existing exact project name/ID lookup still runs; a different project ID refuses before saveAs. Use an independently observed destination identity before pinning first-save authority; no automatic namespace conversion or project/hub switching occurs.

sections.title: Input Schema And Discovery
sections.text: Required name,project,folder strings and strict confirm:true. Optional description/tag strings default to empty strings; no overwrite, retry, hub, fileId or filesystem fields. Discover accessible exact project names/IDs and folder hierarchy through the active hub's Fusion Data panel or existing hub-listing commands; this operation does not search other hubs or create destinations. project must match exactly one accessible project by case-sensitive name OR ID, with ID/name collisions rejected. folder is a case-sensitive child-name path under that project's root, not folder ID: empty string selects root. Every segment must match exactly one child. No leading/trailing slash, empty/dot/dot-dot segments, backslashes, colon or characters below U+0020. No normalization/path mapping. name must be non-whitespace, already trimmed, not . or .., not end with a dot, contain no characters below U+0020 or / \ : * ? " < > |. Leading dot on an otherwise valid name is allowed; extension is not added/removed. Existing file names are compared case-insensitively across all file types.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains accepted:boolean,pending:boolean,status:complete|pending|failed,targetObserved:boolean,original:statusSnapshot,current:statusSnapshot,target:{name:string,projectId:string,projectName:string,folderId:string,folder:string},copyRequested:boolean,warning:string. Each statusSnapshot is {name:string,creationId:string,saved:boolean,modified:boolean,fileId:string|null,fileName:string|null,version:integer|null,versionId:string|null,isComplete:boolean|null,folderId:string|null,projectId:string|null}. accepted is bool(saveAs return). targetObserved requires current.saved, nonempty new fileId different from original.fileId, and exact target name/project/folder. complete requires accepted,targetObserved,!current.modified,current.isComplete===true. pending is accepted AND not complete; false return gives status:failed,pending:false (not success). copyRequested is bool(original.saved). Shared envelope has success:boolean,operation,document (post-operation name),result,created:[]; false acceptance marks envelope unsuccessful. Before saving, FMCAD_PROGRESS emits operation,state:validated,target,warning; progress is not a save-success result.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Partial Failure
sections.text: Must be invoked separately outside SDK command-related events/command transactions; modeling batches reject it via batchAllowed:false. Handler neither detects host transactions nor schedules around them. Shared wrapper may activate scoped document. confirm authorizes first save or a new copy for already-saved documents, including the open document becoming that copy; original is not separately saved, closed or reopened. Collision preflight is not an atomic cloud reservation; stale listings/concurrent creation remain possible. saveAs errors propagate without retry. Readback errors can occur after accepted save and leave an uncertain copy with no normal result; inspect status/cloud destination before retry. No waiting, progress percentage or automatic save retry. Actual host transaction availability and asynchronous cloud completion are live-only limits, not offline geometry guarantees.

sections.title: Result Wiring
sections.text: Retain result.original.fileId and result.target from this call. Later document.status result must identify a different file at target.name/projectId/folderId with saved:true,modified:false,isComplete:true; the original complete file does not satisfy copy completion. Use the new open name for subsequent document scoping. Never pass target.folderId into folder: folder still requires the logical path string (target.folder). No $ref modeling-batch save-as workflow is supported.

examples.label: First save or copy into existing nested folder
examples.requires: Active hub has exactly one ProductProject and existing unique Designs/Parts child path, no case-insensitive Housing filename collision. Explicit target Design document and transaction-free execution context; confirmation intentionally authorizes a copy if already saved.
examples.output: result.target identifies destination; result.original/current preserve identity snapshots. accepted:true may still mean status:pending.

examples.label: Project root and explicit metadata
examples.requires: Discover ProductProject exactly in active hub; project root exists and HousingRoot is unused. Run outside command transactions, never in modeling batch.
examples.output: result.target.folder is empty string; target.folderId is actual root ID. description/tag are sent but not echoed in result.

sections.title: Identity, Pins And Authorization
sections.text: Invoke document save once with --doc <exact-open-name>, --doc-id <creationId>, --doc-file-id <fileId>, --project-id <projectId> and data {requestId,operationId,projectId,fileId,creationId,expectedVersion,reportPath,confirm:true}. creationId must equal --doc-id, fileId the saved DataFile.id via --doc-file-id, projectId the DataFile.parentProject.id via --project-id, and all four must match the currently open document. requestId and operationId are caller-stable request/operation identities (1..128 letters/digits/underscore/hyphen). expectedVersion is the positive baseline DataFile.versionNumber before this save. confirm is strictly boolean true and authorizes exactly one save of the already-open, already-saved document. description (optional string) names the native save; timeBudgetMs (optional positive integer 1..120000 milliseconds, default 30000) bounds observation of cloud publication and never cancels or retries the save RPC.

sections.title: Single Submission And Immutable Receipt
sections.text: The durable receipt directory is <reportPath>/document-save/<hash(requestId,operationId)> (mode 0700, a real directory, not a symlink). An immutable pre-submit journal record is written before the save RPC, binding the exact request identity and pinned target. Repeating the same requestId/operationId against the same reportPath returns the last persisted record and never sends a second save; a concurrent submit lock also returns without a second save. Journal states are submit_uncertain, accepted, pending, complete, failed, blocked, unknown and noop. Resume observation with document save observe using the exact original request identity.

sections.title: Clean No-Op And Pre-Save Guards
sections.text: The exact target must already be saved and already open. Read-only preflight checks the baseline and document.status before any mutation: name/creationId/fileId/projectId/version must match (drift returns blocked); the target must already be saved; a dirty target must also be cloud complete and writable, already active, and Fusion idle. An already-saved unmodified document returns noop with no save call, unchanged resultingVersion, and cloudComplete reporting the observed DataFile.isComplete bit separately (success true, accepted false). Save is never issued for an unsaved document; first-save/save-as is a separate document.save_as operation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has success,operation,status,requestId,operationId,requestHash,target:{creationId,fileId,projectId,version},accepted,changed,baselineVersion,resultingVersion,cloudComplete,receipt,replayedReceipt,unavailableEvidence. success is true only for status complete and noop; accepted/pending/unknown are not success. accepted means the SDK save returned true but no status read completed within budget; pending means readback still saw publication incomplete; complete requires the same file/project/creation lineage, a version newer than the baseline, saved and unmodified state, and DataFile.isComplete true; unknown means the save outcome or publication attribution is indeterminate (timeout, lost response, or the target was modified after submit) and is never replayed; failed/blocked refused the save. unavailableEvidence lists the exact refusal/uncertainty reason. The shared envelope {success,operation,document,result,created:[]} keeps created empty.

sections.title: Scope And Limits
sections.text: Existing saved open document only: no first-save, save-as, open, close, activation, cold reopen, cloud delete or foreign-document access. The one authorized save is issued through the private internal document.save_native primitive; save_native is not a public operation and has no manual. No default cold test, refresh/save-as fallback or other specialized workflow is invoked. Separate from document.save_as (first-save/copy), document.status (read-only snapshot) and document.clear (content empty). Initial fixture setup (create + first save) is out of scope: the document must already exist, be saved and be open before save once. Offline stubs certify control flow, not live Fusion kernel or cloud durability.

examples.label: Save an already-saved modified document once
examples.requires: The open document is already saved, currently modified, cloud complete, writable, active, and Fusion is idle. Substitute discovered exact IDs from document.status; expectedVersion is the current versionNumber before saving.
examples.output: result.status becomes complete (success true) once readback observes a newer saved unmodified complete version; accepted or pending beforehand. The receipt is durable at reportPath/document-save/<hash>.

examples.label: Clean document no-op
examples.requires: The same pinned target is currently unmodified (document.status modified:false).
examples.output: result.status is noop, success true, accepted false, changed false, resultingVersion equals expectedVersion, and no save call was made.

examples.label: Stale baseline version refuses before saving
examples.requires: The currently observed DataFile.versionNumber no longer equals expectedVersion 2 (for example it is already 3).
examples.output: result.status is blocked, success false, accepted false, changed false; unavailableEvidence reports the baseline version mismatch and no save is sent.

verified: exact doc+creationId/fileId/projectId/version pin and confirm authorization
immutable pre-submit receipt and single-submission lock
clean noop without save and pre-save saved/writable/cloud-complete guards
no replay after timeout/unknown; observe resumes the original request

sections.title: Inputs And Pins
sections.text: Invoke document save observe with the same --doc/--doc-id/--doc-file-id/--project-id context and data {requestId,operationId,projectId,fileId,creationId,expectedVersion,reportPath}. Every field must equal the original document.save.once request exactly: same requestId and operationId, same pinned projectId/fileId/creationId, same expectedVersion baseline, and the same reportPath receipt directory. There is no confirm and no description; timeBudgetMs (optional positive integer 1..120000 milliseconds, default 30000) bounds read-only observation.

sections.title: Read-Only Observation
sections.text: Never calls Document.save, saveAs, open, close, activation or cold reopen, and never replays the save. It reads only the existing request receipt and the exact currently open document status. For a terminal receipt status (noop/complete/failed/blocked) it returns the persisted record unchanged; for accepted/pending it re-reads document.status within the remaining budget to settle completion. Observation is bound by the pinned stable identity (creationId/fileId/projectId), not the display name: a display-name change such as a version suffix does not break observation while that identity still matches.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: A missing receipt or an interrupted submit.lock returns unknown; a corrupt or mismatched receipt returns blocked and never reconciles. The result shape matches document.save.once (success,operation,status,requestId,operationId,requestHash,target,accepted,changed,baselineVersion,resultingVersion,cloudComplete,receipt,replayedReceipt,unavailableEvidence) with operation document.save.observe. complete/pending/failed/unknown describe publication evidence only, not model geometry or application correctness; unknown is not success and no retry is offered.

examples.label: Observe the original save request
examples.requires: document.save.once was previously issued with these exact fields and reportPath, and the document remains the same open target.
examples.output: result reuses the persisted receipt; it reports complete once publication is observed, or stays accepted/pending/unknown without issuing another save.

verified: missing receipt and interrupted submit lock return unknown
terminal noop/complete/failed/blocked replayed; accepted/pending re-observed within budget
